title: Figures 2–3. NASA gridded ion thruster and P5 Hall thruster photos; Hall field diagram
description: Photograph of a 30 cm diameter gridded ion thruster on a test stand, captioned "Figure 2. Electrostatic Gridded Ion Thrusters" and noted as tested at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Below, Figure 3 pairs a cylinder diagram labeled "Hall Field Orientation" showing B, E, and ExB vectors with inflow and outflow arrows, alongside a photograph of a blue-glowing P5 Hall Effect thruster being tested at the University of Michigan. Captioned "Figure 3. Field Orientation for Hall Field Systems and P5 Hall Thruster."
